mutationThresholds.rationale: Codec mutations cross trust, migration, and semantic round-trip boundaries; every registered semantic mutant must be killed.
Transducer, L-system, and pumping probes alter user-visible semantic outcomes; every registered mutant must be killed.
Framework probes certify fail-closed reporting itself; a survivor would invalidate the certification result.
Parser and grammar mutations change membership, conversion, or trace semantics; every registered mutant must be killed.
Graph probes target layout, mapping, and history invariants with deterministic oracles; every registered mutant must be killed.
PDA probes alter acceptance and stack behavior; every registered semantic mutant must be killed.
Regular-language probes alter acceptance, closure, or conversion semantics; every registered mutant must be killed.
TM probes alter transition and bounded execution semantics; every registered mutant must be killed.
